name: es-irpf-deductions-attributable-tax
description: Work out the regional tax attributable to selected income for Spanish resident IRPF regional credits in 2026. Covers the separate state and regional general and savings quotas, minimum spillover, general average rates with excess decimals discarded, the numerator N for social-housing rent, work moves and public aid, the A step for aid in the liquidable base, joint returns, signed losses, and the per-community calculation for Aragón social housing, Castilla-La Mancha, Cantabria and Canarias work moves, Asturias, Extremadura, Galicia, Illes Balears, Cataluña and Comunitat Valenciana aid credits. Use for cuota íntegra autonómica atribuible, tipo medio de gravamen, deducción por cambio de residencia, ayudas ELA, ayudas a afectados por la talidomida and vivienda social. Load es-irpf-deductions for the order of credits and the regional Guide for each credit's entitlement. Split unchanged from es-irpf-deductions on 6 November 2026.
